```{r summaries}
    by = c("dataset", "method", "nutrient")

round_combo_table <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      RMSE = round(RMSE, 2),
      R2 = round(R2, 3),
      cont_spearman = round(cont_spearman, 3),
      overall_score = round(overall_score, 3),
      zone_r2 = round(zone_r2, 3),
      zone_spearman = round(zone_spearman, 3),
      epsilon2 = round(epsilon2, 3),
      p_adj_BH = signif(p_adj_BH, 3)
    )
}

table_SP_OK   <- round_combo_table(table_SP_OK)
table_SP_RF   <- round_combo_table(table_SP_RF)
table_SP_RK   <- round_combo_table(table_SP_RK)
table_COMP_OK <- round_combo_table(table_COMP_OK)
table_COMP_RF <- round_combo_table(table_COMP_RF)
table_COMP_RK <- round_combo_table(table_COMP_RK)

add_flags <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      cont_strength = case_when(
        !is.na(R2) & R2 >= 0.30 ~ "strong",
        !is.na(R2) & R2 >= 0.15 ~ "moderate",
        !is.na(R2) ~ "weak",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      zone_strength = case_when(
        !is.na(zone_r2) & zone_r2 >= 0.25 ~ "strong",
        !is.na(zone_r2) & zone_r2 >= 0.10 ~ "moderate",
        !is.na(zone_r2) ~ "weak",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      zone_sig = case_when(
        !is.na(p_adj_BH) & p_adj_BH < 0.05 ~ "yes",
        !is.na(p_adj_BH) ~ "no",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
}

table_SP_RF   <- add_flags(table_SP_RF)
table_SP_RK   <- add_flags(table_SP_RK)
table_COMP_OK <- add_flags(table_COMP_OK)
table_COMP_RF <- add_flags(table_COMP_RF)
table_COMP_RK <- add_flags(table_COMP_RK)
```

```{r bootstrap VIP}
#VIP
covariate_stack <- terra::rast("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariate_stack/covariate_stack_3m.tif")
cov_names <- names(covariate_stack)

get_dataset_objects <- function(dataset_name) {
  if (dataset_name == "SP") {
    list(
      sf_data = soil_SP_cov,
      resamples = resamples_SP
    )
  } else if (dataset_name == "COMP") {
    list(
      sf_data = soil_COMP_cov,
      resamples = resamples_COMP
    )
  } else {
    stop("dataset_name must be 'SP' or 'COMP'")
  }
}

extract_rf_importance_one <- function(dataset_name, method_name, variable_name, iter_row,
                                      covariates_use, ntree = 500) {
  
  if (!method_name %in% c("RF", "RK")) return(NULL)
  
  objs <- get_dataset_objects(dataset_name)
  sf_data <- objs$sf_data
  resamples <- objs$resamples
  
  split <- resamples[[iter_row$iteration]]
  train_sf <- sf_data[split$train_ids, ]
  
  # only keep predictors that actually exist
  predictors_present <- intersect(covariates_use, names(train_sf))
  
  train_df <- train_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(c(variable_name, predictors_present))) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  if (nrow(train_df) < 5) return(NULL)
  if (length(predictors_present) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  mtry_use <- iter_row$best_mtry
  if (!is.finite(mtry_use)) {
    mtry_use <- max(1, floor(sqrt(length(predictors_present))))
  }
  mtry_use <- min(mtry_use, length(predictors_present))
  
  set.seed(iter_row$seed)
  
  rf_fit <- randomForest(
    x = train_df[, predictors_present, drop = FALSE],
    y = train_df[[variable_name]],
    ntree = ntree,
    mtry = mtry_use,
    importance = TRUE
  )
  
  imp <- randomForest::importance(rf_fit)
  imp <- as.data.frame(imp)
  imp$predictor <- rownames(imp)
  
  tibble(
    predictor = imp$predictor,
    inc_mse = if ("%IncMSE" %in% names(imp)) imp[["%IncMSE"]] else NA_real_,
    inc_node_purity = if ("IncNodePurity" %in% names(imp)) imp[["IncNodePurity"]] else NA_real_
  )
}

extract_weighted_importance <- function(selected_iters, dataset_name, method_name, variable_name,
                                        covariates_use, ntree = 500) {
  
  sel <- selected_iters %>%
    filter(
      dataset == dataset_name,
      method == method_name,
      variable == variable_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(weight))
  
  if (nrow(sel) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  out_list <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sel))) {
    imp_tbl <- extract_rf_importance_one(
      dataset_name = dataset_name,
      method_name = method_name,
      variable_name = variable_name,
      iter_row = sel[i, ],
      covariates_use = covariates_use,
      ntree = ntree
    )
    
    if (!is.null(imp_tbl)) {
      out_list[[k]] <- imp_tbl %>%
        mutate(
          dataset = dataset_name,
          method = method_name,
          nutrient = variable_name,
          iteration = sel$iteration[i],
          seed = sel$seed[i],
          model_weight = sel$weight[i]
        )
      k <- k + 1
    }
  }
  
  if (length(out_list) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  bind_rows(out_list)
}
```

```{r individual mz maps}
# rebuild ensemble raster object from saved rasters
final_ensemble_rasters <- list()

for (ds in c("SP", "COMP")) {
  final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]] <- list()
  
  for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
    final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]] <- list()
    
    for (v in soil_vars) {
      f_mean <- paste0(
        "../outputs/checkpoints/rasters/ensemble_mean/",
        ds, "_", meth, "_", v, "_mean.tif"
      )
      
      f_sd <- paste0(
        "../outputs/checkpoints/rasters/ensemble_sd/",
        ds, "_", meth, "_", v, "_sd.tif"
      )
      
      if (file.exists(f_mean) && file.exists(f_sd)) {
        final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]] <- list(
          mean = terra::rast(f_mean),
          sd   = terra::rast(f_sd)
        )
      } else {
        final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]] <- NULL
      }
    }
  }
}
fit_single_nutrient_kmeans <- function(r, k = 4, n_samp = 10000, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  samp <- terra::spatSample(
    r,
    size = n_samp,
    method = "random",
    na.rm = TRUE,
    as.df = TRUE,
    warn = FALSE
  )
  
  samp <- as.data.frame(samp)
  names(samp) <- "value"
  samp <- samp[is.finite(samp$value), , drop = FALSE]
  
  if (nrow(samp) < k) stop("Too few valid sampled cells for k-means.")
  
  x <- scale(samp$value)
  
  km <- kmeans(x, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  
  list(
    model = km,
    centers_scaled = as.numeric(km$centers[, 1]),
    scale_center = attr(x, "scaled:center"),
    scale_scale = attr(x, "scaled:scale"),
    sampled_values = samp$value
  )
}

assign_single_nutrient_zones <- function(r, zone_fit, filename = NULL, overwrite = TRUE) {
  centers <- zone_fit$centers_scaled
  mu <- zone_fit$scale_center
  sdv <- zone_fit$scale_scale
  
  zone_fun <- function(v) {
    out <- rep(NA_integer_, length(v))
    ok <- is.finite(v)
    if (!any(ok)) return(out)
    
    x_scaled <- (v[ok] - mu) / sdv
    
    dmat <- sapply(centers, function(cc) (x_scaled - cc)^2)
    if (is.null(dim(dmat))) dmat <- matrix(dmat, ncol = length(centers))
    
    out[ok] <- max.col(-dmat, ties.method = "first")
    out
  }
  
  if (is.null(filename)) {
    z <- terra::app(r, fun = zone_fun)
  } else {
    z <- terra::app(
      r,
      fun = zone_fun,
      filename = filename,
      overwrite = overwrite,
      wopt = list(datatype = "INT2S")
    )
  }
  
  names(z) <- "zone"
  z
}

relabel_single_nutrient_zones <- function(zone_raster, value_raster, ds, meth, nutrient) {
  z_vals <- terra::values(zone_raster, mat = FALSE)
  v_vals <- terra::values(value_raster, mat = FALSE)
  
  lut <- tibble(
    zone = z_vals,
    value = v_vals
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(zone), is.finite(value)) %>%
    group_by(zone) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(mean_value) %>%
    mutate(
      new_zone = row_number(),
      label = paste0("Zone ", new_zone)
    )
  
  new_vals <- z_vals
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(lut))) {
    new_vals[z_vals == lut$zone[i]] <- lut$new_zone[i]
  }
  
  out <- zone_raster
  terra::values(out) <- new_vals
  names(out) <- paste(ds, meth, nutrient, "zone", sep = "_")
  
  list(
    raster = out,
    lookup = lut %>% mutate(dataset = ds, method = meth, nutrient = nutrient)
  )
}

single_nutrient_zone_rasters <- list()
single_nutrient_zone_lookup <- list()

for (ds in c("SP", "COMP")) {
  single_nutrient_zone_rasters[[ds]] <- list()
  
  for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
    single_nutrient_zone_rasters[[ds]][[meth]] <- list()
    
    for (v in soil_vars) {
      cat("Creating single-nutrient zones for", ds, meth, v, "\n")
      
      obj <- final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]]
      if (is.null(obj) || is.null(obj$mean)) {
        single_nutrient_zone_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]] <- NULL
        next
      }
      
      r <- obj$mean
      vals <- terra::values(r, mat = FALSE)
      
      if (sum(is.finite(vals)) < 20) {
        single_nutrient_zone_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]] <- NULL
        next
      }
      
      out <- tryCatch({
        fit <- fit_single_nutrient_kmeans(r, k = 4, n_samp = 10000, seed = 123)
        z_raw <- assign_single_nutrient_zones(r, fit)
        z_rel <- relabel_single_nutrient_zones(z_raw, r, ds, meth, v)
        
        single_nutrient_zone_lookup[[paste(ds, meth, v, sep = "_")]] <- z_rel$lookup
        z_rel$raster
      }, error = function(e) {
        message("Failed for ", ds, " ", meth, " ", v, ": ", e$message)
        NULL
      })
      
      single_nutrient_zone_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]] <- out
    }
  }
}

single_nutrient_zone_lookup_tbl <- bind_rows(single_nutrient_zone_lookup)
single_nutrient_zone_lookup_tbl

plot_single_nutrient_zone_maps <- function(zone_list, dataset_name, method_name, vars_use = soil_vars) {
  op <- par(mfrow = c(3, 3), mar = c(3, 3, 2, 1))
  
  for (v in vars_use) {
    z <- zone_list[[dataset_name]][[method_name]][[v]]
    if (!is.null(z)) {
      plot(z, main = paste(dataset_name, method_name, v))
    } else {
      plot.new()
      title(main = paste(dataset_name, method_name, v, "\nNo map"))
    }
  }
  
  par(op)
}


#plot all, SP COMP OK RF RK:
for (ds in c("SP", "COMP")) {
  for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
    plot_single_nutrient_zone_maps(single_nutrient_zone_rasters, ds, meth)
  }
}

dir.create("../outputs/single_nutrient_zones", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (ds in c("SP", "COMP")) {

    for (v in soil_vars) {

      if (is.null(z)) next
      
      terra::writeRaster(
        z,
        filename = paste0("../outputs/single_nutrient_zones/", ds, "_", meth, "_", v, "_zones.tif"),
        overwrite = TRUE
      )
    }
  }
}
```

```{r individual validation}
#validate individual nutrient zones

val_var_lookup <- c(
  "ca" = "Ca_0_15",
  "k" = "K_0_15",
  "mg" = "Mg_0_15",
  "mn" = "Mn_0_15",
  "p" = "P_0_15",
  "zn" = "Zn_0_15",
  "p_h_2" = "pH.2_0_15",
  "lbc_1" = "LBC.1_0_15",
  "lb_ceq" = "LBCeq_0_15"
)

# extract zone values from each single-nutrient zone raster to validation points
extract_single_nutrient_zone_validation <- function(ap_val_sf, single_nutrient_zone_rasters, val_var_lookup) {
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (ds in c("SP", "COMP")) {
    for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
      for (v in names(val_var_lookup)) {
        
        z <- single_nutrient_zone_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]]
        if (is.null(z)) next
        
        ext <- terra::extract(z, terra::vect(ap_val_sf))
        obs_col <- val_var_lookup[[v]]
        
        tmp <- ap_val_sf %>%
          st_drop_geometry() %>%
          transmute(
            Point = Point,
            dataset = ds,
            method = meth,
            nutrient = v,
            observed = .data[[obs_col]],
            zone = ext[, 2]
          ) %>%
          filter(!is.na(observed), !is.na(zone))
        
        out[[k]] <- tmp
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out)
}

single_zone_val_tbl <- extract_single_nutrient_zone_validation(
  ap_val_sf,
  single_nutrient_zone_rasters,
  val_var_lookup
)

single_zone_val_tbl

# summarize validation for long-format single-nutrient zone table
single_zone_validation_summary <- function(single_zone_val_tbl) {
  kw_out <- list()
  trend_out <- list()
  r2_out <- list()
  k1 <- 1
  k2 <- 1
  k3 <- 1
  
  for (ds in unique(single_zone_val_tbl$dataset)) {
    for (meth in unique(single_zone_val_tbl$method)) {
      for (nut in unique(single_zone_val_tbl$nutrient)) {
        
        dat <- single_zone_val_tbl %>%
          filter(dataset == ds, method == meth, nutrient == nut) %>%
          mutate(
            zone = factor(zone),
            zone_num = as.numeric(zone)
          )
        
        if (nrow(dat) < 5 || n_distinct(dat$zone) < 2) next
        
        # Kruskal-Wallis
        kw <- kruskal.test(observed ~ zone, data = dat)
        H <- as.numeric(kw$statistic)
        n <- nrow(dat)
        k_groups <- n_distinct(dat$zone)
        eps2 <- (H - k_groups + 1) / (n - k_groups)
        
        kw_out[[k1]] <- tibble(
          dataset = ds,
          method = meth,
          nutrient = nut,
          n_points = n,
          n_zones = k_groups,
          statistic = H,
          p_value = kw$p.value,
          epsilon2 = eps2
        )
        k1 <- k1 + 1
        
        # Spearman trend
        tr <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(dat$zone_num, dat$observed, method = "spearman"))
        trend_out[[k2]] <- tibble(
          dataset = ds,
          method = meth,
          nutrient = nut,
          n_points = n,
          spearman_rho = unname(tr$estimate),
          p_value = tr$p.value
        )
        k2 <- k2 + 1
        
        # Zone R²
        mod <- lm(observed ~ zone, data = dat)
        r2_out[[k3]] <- tibble(
          dataset = ds,
          method = meth,
          nutrient = nut,
          n_points = n,
          zone_r2 = summary(mod)$r.squared
        )
        k3 <- k3 + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  kw_tbl <- bind_rows(kw_out) %>%
    group_by(nutrient) %>%
    mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  trend_tbl <- bind_rows(trend_out) %>%
    group_by(nutrient) %>%
    mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  r2_tbl <- bind_rows(r2_out)
  
  list(
    kw = kw_tbl,
    trend = trend_tbl,
    r2 = r2_tbl
  )
}

single_zone_validation <- single_zone_validation_summary(single_zone_val_tbl)

single_zone_kw_tbl <- single_zone_validation$kw
single_zone_trend_tbl <- single_zone_validation$trend
single_zone_r2_tbl <- single_zone_validation$r2

single_zone_kw_tbl
single_zone_trend_tbl
single_zone_r2_tbl

  left_join(
    single_zone_trend_tbl %>%
      select(dataset, method, nutrient, spearman_rho, p_adj_BH) %>%
      rename(zone_spearman = spearman_rho,

    by = c("dataset", "method", "nutrient")
```
